description: This header file declares APIs and data structures for managing static IP configuration, subnet management, port management, and firewall rules within a data model for a networking device. It defines function signatures for getting and setting parameters, validation, commit, rollback, and managing entries in tables such as subnets, port management, and rules.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for true static IP configuration.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value related to static IP configuration.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for static IP configuration.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for static IP configuration.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_Validate
methods.description: Validates the static IP configuration parameters.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to static IP configuration.

methods.name: TrueStaticIP_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back uncommitted changes to static IP configuration.

methods.name: Subnet_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of subnet entries.

methods.name: Subnet_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subnet entry.

methods.name: Subnet_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new subnet entry.

methods.name: Subnet_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specified subnet entry.

methods.name: Subnet_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a subnet parameter.

methods.name: Subnet_Validate
methods.description: Validates subnet parameters before committing.

methods.name: Subnet_Commit
methods.description: Commits subnet configuration changes.

methods.name: Subnet_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts subnet configuration to previous state.

methods.name: PortManagement_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter for port management.

methods.name: PortManagement_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter for port management.

methods.name: PortManagement_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for port management.

methods.name: PortManagement_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter for port management.

methods.name: PortManagement_Validate
methods.description: Validates port management parameters.

methods.name: PortManagement_Commit
methods.description: Commits port management configuration changes.

methods.name: PortManagement_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts port management configuration to previous state.

methods.name: Rule_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of firewall rule entries.

methods.name: Rule_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific firewall rule entry.

methods.name: Rule_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new firewall rule entry.

methods.name: Rule_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specified firewall rule.

methods.name: Rule_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a rule.

methods.name: Rule_Validate
methods.description: Validates firewall rule parameters before applying.

methods.name: Rule_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to firewall rules.

methods.name: Rule_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts firewall rule changes.
